facts.business: Abate AS Industries Limited operates eye hospitals and has investments in healthcare, education, real estate, supermarkets, electronics, and mobile retail across India and Bahrain.

capacity_or_capex.item: 44 world-class international eye hospitals under development

key_risks: Investments constitute major portion of total assets; impairment risk
Dependence on promoter-led strategic restructuring and international expansion
No dividend payout; retained earnings for expansion
facts.related_party_note: Preferential allotment via share swap to acquire stakes in Salamath Import and Export Private Limited, Prudential Management Services Private Limited, Sky International Trading WLL Bahrain, and SAIA Educational Support Services WLL Bahrain, making the first three subsidiaries and the last an associate.
